name: Hit the Road
source:
Would you like to take a chance at least once in your lifetime and go on a thirty-day trip to various states of America in the company of complete strangers?

The protagonist of visual novel "Hit the Road" decided to spend his summer like this: gather a small group of enthusiasts to travel across the boundless immense landscapes in a small but cozy camper.

During these thirty days, our hero will not only visit new places, but he will also learn the fate of his precious companions.

Summer filled with the spirit of freedom may not be so rosy if you forget about one simple rule: "Think about nearest and dearest, but do not forget about yourself."

Will our hero reveal other people's dark secrets? Will he find answers to his own questions?

Will this weekend become a crucial point? Only time will tell.

[From [url=https://rinran.itch.io/hit-the-road]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是否也想在人生中至少冒一次险，与一群素不相识的人结伴，花上30天游历美国各州？

视觉小说《Hit the Road》的主角决定这样度过自己的夏天：召集几位志同道合的旅行爱好者，乘着一辆小巧却舒适的房车，穿行于辽阔无垠的天地间。

在这30天里，主角不仅会领略陌生的风景，还将了解几位珍贵旅伴的人生际遇。

充满自由气息的夏天，未必总是那么美好，尤其当你忘记了这条简单的原则：“惦记身边珍爱的人，也别忘了自己。”

主角能否揭开他人隐藏的黑暗秘密？能否找到自己所寻求的答案？

这个周末会成为关键的转折点吗？只有时间能给出答案。

[摘自[url=https://rinran.itch.io/hit-the-road]itch.io[/url]]
